jobs.description:
Description

As part of the AWS Applied AI Solutions organization, we have a vision to provide business applications, leveraging Amazon’s unique experience and expertise, that are used by millions of companies worldwide to manage day-to-day operations. We will accomplish this by accelerating our customers’ businesses through delivery of intuitive and differentiated technology solutions that solve enduring business challenges. We blend vision with curiosity and Amazon’s real-world experience to build opinionated, turnkey solutions. Where customers prefer to buy over build, we become their trusted partner with solutions that are no-brainers to buy and easy to use.

AWS Applied AI Solutions' (AAIS) vision is every business innovating with Amazon AI teammates. Our mission is to build delightful AI solutions that improve human capabilities and business outcomes. The Agentic WorkSpaces organization within AAIS envisions a world where people, teams, and AI collaborate securely from anywhere to create unprecedented value for every organization. We build lovable products that empower every business to unlock the full potential of human-AI teamwork, driving smarter decisions, greater creativity, more value, and faster innovation with confidence.

Within Agentic WorkSpaces, our team is building WorkSpaces for Agents (W4A) where this vision meets enterprise reality. W4A enables AI agents to work the way humans do, with access to real applications, real interfaces, and real computing environments. We're building foundational infrastructure that allows autonomous agents to securely provision, interact with, and manage computing sessions at scale. Enterprises want to use AI agents for critical business workloads that touch legacy desktop applications and mainframes, yet 75% of organizations run legacy applications that lack modern APIs. WorkSpaces for Agents solves this painful problem: it gives enterprises the ability to connect their AI agents to a secure, governed, cloud desktop environment where agents can operate both legacy and modern applications directly, just as an employee would, without costly migrations.

We are seeking a Senior Manager, Software Development to build and lead the engineering organization for WorkSpaces for Agents. This is a foundational leadership role on a product defining a new category: enterprise-grade desktop environments purpose-built for AI agents. You will hire, grow, and lead the engineering teams that build the systems letting autonomous agents securely provision sessions and operate desktop and mainframe applications, inside the compliance envelope that regulated enterprises require. The problems your teams will solve do not have established industry patterns. You will own delivery and set the organizational direction for how AI agents interact with computing environments at enterprise scale.

What You Will Do

Build and lead the engineering organization. Hire, develop, and retain high-caliber engineering managers and senior engineers. Set the talent bar, create growth paths, and build the culture that makes W4A a destination for the best builders.

Own end-to-end delivery of the solution. Drive the roadmap and execution for how AI agents, from any framework, securely provision, connect to, and operate within WorkSpaces sessions: session lifecycle, multi-tenant isolation, elastic scaling, and cross-platform compatibility.

Deliver the tooling and governance layers that make agents effective and trusted. Lead the teams building the managed MCP service and forwarded tools that improve agent accuracy while reducing cost, and the security model — session isolation, agent identity, permission boundaries, audit trails, and human-in-the-loop controls — that enterprises require.

Balance invention with operational rigor. WorkSpaces has served enterprise customers for over a decade and operates at massive scale. You will build a new product category on this foundation while maintaining the reliability that customers depend on.

Drive cross-organizational execution. Partner across AgentCore, Identity, Security, Networking, and the MCP ecosystem — and with product, science, and program leaders — to resolve dependencies and ship a coherent system.

Key job responsibilities

Set organizational direction and delivery strategy: Define the multi-year execution roadmap for W4A engineering, structure the teams to deliver it, and secure buy-in from VP-level leadership.

Hire and grow engineering talent: Own recruiting, calibration, development, and retention across engineers and engineering managers. Mentor toward senior and principal scope, and raise the engineering bar across the organization.

Deliver highly ambiguous, novel systems: Lead teams through foundational challenges in agent-computer interaction — session lifecycle, isolation, scaling, and cross-OS compatibility — where neither the approach nor the success criteria are pre-defined.

Own operational excellence at enterprise scale: Ensure the systems meet the security, reliability, availability, and auditability bar that regulated enterprises require, and establish the operational mechanisms that sustain them.

Deliver measurable business impact: Ensure execution translates to customer outcomes: faster setup, lower cost-per-action, higher task accuracy, reduced blast radius, and the operational metrics that demonstrate enterprise trust is being earned.

Drive cross-organizational technical alignment: Work across partner teams to shape roadmaps, resolve architectural dependencies, and ensure cross-cutting decisions compose into a coherent system.

Partner with product and science: Turn product vision and applied research into shipped capability.

Salesforce is the #1 AI CRM, where humans with agents drive customer success together. Here, ambition meets action. Tech meets trust. And innovation isn’t a buzzword — it’s a way of life. The Experience

The Authentication Platform Engineering Manager leads the team responsible for the core identity services that power Salesforce's production infrastructure, including Kerberos-based authentication, Time-based One-Time Password (TOTP), and Fast Identity Online 2 (FIDO2) systems. This role sits at the heart of our Production Identity and Access Management (IAM) stack, ensuring every access request across our global fleet is secure, authenticated, and resilient. You will manage a team of specialists who bridge legacy infrastructure protocols and modern, cloud-native identity standards to defend against sophisticated threats.

What You'll Actually Be Doing

Drive the strategy and execution for the Authentication Platform, ensuring these foundational services scale horizontally across diverse environments.
Provide technical leadership across a diverse protocol stack, from Kerberos and Lightweight Directory Access Protocol (LDAP) to modern WebAuthn/FIDO2 and TOTP implementations.
Guarantee the reliability of services that are foundational dependencies for the entire company, targeting high availability standards.
Partner with security architects to implement Zero Trust principles, ensuring the platform enforces strict adherence to least privilege and robust identity verification.
Develop each engineer's ability to work effectively in an AI-augmented environment, moving beyond tracking output to actively coaching growth into higher-level system design and architecture work.
Own how AI tools are integrated into the team's daily development cycle, including configuration, feedback loops, and the judgment calls about when human review is required to validate output.

You have experience building or maintaining enterprise-grade Identity Providers (IdP) or Multi-Factor Authentication (MFA) platforms.

Description

Do you want to work to make Power for Good?

We're the world's largest independent renewable energy company, guided by a simple yet powerful vision to create a future where everyone has access to affordable, zero carbon energy.

We know that achieving our ambitions would be impossible without our people. Because we're tackling some of the world's toughest problems, we need the very best people to help us. They're our most important asset so that's why we continually invest in them.

RES is a family with a diverse workforce, and we are dedicated to the personal and professional growth of our people, no matter what stage of their careers they're at. We can promise you rewarding work which makes a real impact, the chance to learn from inspiring colleagues from across a growing, global network and opportunities to grow personally and professionally.

Our competitive package offers a wide range of benefits and rewards.

The position

RES is establishing a Director of Applications and AI Automation to lead the build engine for its enterprise application estate and its AI-enabled solutions. Reporting to the Group Chief Information Officer, the role owns the strategy, delivery and governance of application development, automation and real-time integration across RES — from core ERP through to AI agents and automations — within the company's Demand to Build to Run operating model and a flat-cost funding constraint.

The role brings together, under a single leader: ERP development on IFS; custom and legacy application development; low-code and citizen development on the Power Platform; workflow, robotic and agentic automation; real-time application integration on Boomi; and the AI application platform on which RES builds — the model gateway, agent runtime and registry, and the associated evaluation and consumption controls.

The role also sets the standard for AI-assisted software development across RES engineering, and governs the development and use of AI-enabled applications and automations. It is a key leader for enterprise-wide AI governance via collaboration with the leader of Data and AI Analytics.

The role reports to the Group CIO and can be based in the United Kingdom or Spain. Fluency in Spanish is preferred.

Accountabilities

Set and own the applications, automation and AI-solutions strategy and roadmap, aligned to demand shaped by Business Technology and gated through Delivery Governance.
Lead ERP development on IFS while incorporating and winding down legacy ERP platforms.
Lead custom and legacy application development and own the development and lifecycle direction of the existing application portfolio.
Own automation across RES — low-code and citizen development on the Power Platform, workflow and robotic automation, and agentic solutions — setting the platforms, standards and governance under which business functions build their own automations.
Own real-time application integration on Boomi, ensuring reliable, secure and well-documented interfaces between applications, including any interface that writes into a system of record.
Own the AI application platform — model gateway, agent runtime and registry, evaluation practice and consumption cost control — operated as a shared service, with a defined service commitment to Data and AI Analytics for the model and machine-learning workloads it takes on as that capability is matured.
Set group-wide standards for AI-assisted software development, covering agentic development tooling, code provenance, review and security expectations, applying to every engineering team across IT.
Govern the development and use of AI-enabled applications and automations, setting responsible-AI, quality, security and lifecycle standards, and contribute to the cross-functional AI governance forum without owning it.
Ensure every solution is designed for the Demand to Build to Run model and handed cleanly to Platform Operations against defined run-readiness criteria.
Deliver effective solutions that drive efficiency and a focus on value for RES.
Uphold architecture conformance with Enterprise and Solution Architecture, and security-by-design with Cyber Security.
Build, develop and lead a high-performing, globally distributed team across the United Kingdom, the United States, Spain and offshore.
Manage vendors, licences and budgets across the application, integration and AI platform estate, within the group commercial framework owned by the Office of the CIO.

Knowledge

Enterprise application landscapes, including ERP (IFS or comparable) and their role in an asset-intensive business.
Modern application development, integration patterns and platform-based delivery.
Automation platforms and practice: low-code and citizen development, workflow and robotic automation, and agentic solutions.
AI application platforms: model gateways, agent runtimes, retrieval and tool-access patterns, evaluation practice and consumption cost management.
Responsible-AI practice, and the governance of AI-assisted development.
Application integration platforms (Boomi or comparable) and real-time interface design.
Demand-build-run, or product and platform, operating models and run-readiness disciplines.

Skills

Setting strategy and translating shaped business demand into deliverable, supportable solutions.
Leading and developing distributed, multi-country technical teams, including through re-skilling.
Delivering to quality, security and lifecycle standards within fixed cost envelopes.
Holding a working boundary with a peer function without escalating routine decisions.
Strong commercial, vendor and budget management.
Clear stakeholder management and communication to executive level.

Experience

Senior leadership of application development or digital delivery functions at scale, ideally in asset-intensive, energy or infrastructure sectors.
Delivering ERP (IFS or comparable) alongside modern application, automation and AI capabilities.
Putting AI-enabled applications or agents into production use, with the governance to match.
Taking ownership of legacy application estates and setting a clear modernisation or retirement path.
Operating a demand-build-run or product and platform operating model with a clean build-to-run handover.

Degree in a relevant discipline, or equivalent professional experience.
Relevant professional certifications — for example in enterprise architecture, application or integration platforms, portfolio delivery, or responsible AI — are advantageous.
Fluency in Spanish is preferred.

At AMD, we believe technology has the power to solve the world’s most important challenges. From advancing healthcare and scientific discovery to powering AI and the technologies people rely on every day, innovation at AMD is shaping the future.

Whether you’re designing next-gen processors, enabling AI breakthroughs, or bringing leading edge products to market, every role at AMD contributes to something bigger — technology that moves the world forward. Join us and, together, we’ll advance your career.

new_jobs.description:
Anduril Industries is a defense technology company with a mission to transform U.S. and allied military capabilities with advanced technology. By bringing the expertise, technology, and business model of the 21st century’s most innovative companies to the defense industry, Anduril is changing how military systems are designed, built and sold. Anduril’s family of systems is powered by Lattice OS, an AI-powered operating system that turns thousands of data streams into a realtime, 3D command and control center. As the world enters an era of strategic competition, Anduril is committed to bringing cutting-edge autonomy, AI, computer vision, sensor fusion, and networking technology to the military in months, not years.

About The Team

The duty of this organization is to enable our Customers’ ongoing Mission Readiness
. From the moment they say '“go” until the contract is fulfilled. We are only successful when the customer's mission is successful.

Mission Readiness is the post-production shared services organization for Anduril. This team supports the Business Lines and Divisions throughout the lifecycle of their product, from initial sustainment concept through delivery, installation, operation, repair and return. These service offerings also include providing technical publications, training, customer support, connectivity services and other value-added services. To the degree the Business elects, we accept the delegated responsibility for upfront and continued delivery of the committed service solutions. This team endeavors to provide the Business Lines, as our internal customers, shared mission services that are more efficient and cost effective than if they chose to provide them directly. By offering mission support capabilities and capacity that are not “core” to the Business, the Business can focus resources on addressing the next big need while we ensure existing commitments are met.

About The Job

We are looking for a Head of Maintenance, Repair and Overhaul (MRO) to join our rapidly growing team in Columbus, OH or Costa Mesa, CA
. In this role, you will be responsible for establishing and running the repair function for Anduril products and components. You will need to lay out the roadmap for product maintenance, leveraging the ground taken by various product teams to date, to enable the high volume and complexity of the fast-growing Anduril installed base. This will require working with the Business Lines - our internal customers - and their Production teams to isolate what makes their products (hardware, embedded software and related aftermarket services) unique and what they have in common that can result in scalable efficiencies. Anduril moves quickly, so “building the plane while flying” rules apply. If you are someone who knows how what great MRO organizations need, where they go wrong and want to create one from a clean sheet using all your lessons learned, then this role is for you.

What You’ll Do

Establish MRO function for Anduril; aggregate the limited existing team, provide strategic and tactical direction, and build out team skills and capacity.
Design and build the MRO organization (including staffing, footprint, tools and processes).
Collaborate closely with Production (including manufacturing, supply chain, material planning, scheduling) to ensure material needs are met for the used/repaired product availability to support deployed equipment uptime commitments as well as sub-component material needs.
Coordinate with supply chain and programs to manage subcontract component repairs, where applicable, and conduct insource/outsource decisions in support of business line priorities.
Prioritize repair backlog, turn-around-time (TAT) and costs in support of all Divisions/Business Lines priorities

Required Qualifications

Bachelors degree in technical or business discipline
10+ years of combined experience in aircraft systems/components MRO (required), sustainment, operations, quality, program management, and/or customer support functions
Ability to travel 25-75% of the time (depending on base location)
This position is based in Costa Mesa, CA or Columbus, OH and requires being onsite - remote work not considered
Eligible to obtain and maintain an active U.S. Secret or Top Secret security clearance

Preferred Qualifications

Extensive technical experience in maintenance, repair, and overhaul, including a comprehensive understanding of aircraft systems, components, and avionics.
Strong knowledge of maintenance best practices, troubleshooting techniques, and diagnostic tools used in the military aviation industry.
Experience managing complex MRO projects, including coordinating with OEMs, subcontractors, and maintenance crews.
Proven track record of successfully building and leading technical teams and overseeing MRO operations for a variety of products.
Proficient in interpreting technical manuals, schematics, and engineering drawings related to component, system and/or aircraft MRO.
Familiarity with military regulations and requirements related to MRO, such as DoD standards and military airworthiness criteria.
Experience ‘standing up’ MRO organization(s), particularly in the context of products ramping production and fielding
Prior success leading in a complex/matrix organization supporting multiple product families. Ability to influence decisions and collaborate in a cross-functional environment.
Understanding of reliability-centered maintenance (RCM) principles and experience in implementing maintenance programs for both condition-based and hard-time maintenance.
Knowledge of software systems used in MRO operations, such as computerized maintenance management systems (CMMS) and aircraft health monitoring systems.
MBA or advanced technical degree preferred

US Salary Range

$220,000—$292,000 USD

Benefits

The salary range for this role is an estimate based on a wide range of compensation factors, inclusive of base salary only. Actual salary offer may vary based on (but not limited to) work experience, education and/or training, critical skills, and/or business considerations. Highly competitive equity grants are included in the majority of full time offers; and are considered part of Anduril's total compensation package. Additionally, Anduril offers top-tier benefits for full-time employees, including:

At Anduril, we invest in our people. Our comprehensive, competitive benefits package (available at little to no cost to employees) ensures you’re supported in health, recovery, and whatever comes next. For more information, Explore Our Benefits.

Protecting Yourself from Recruitment Scams

Anduril is committed to maintaining the integrity of our Talent acquisition process and the security of our candidates. We've observed a rise in sophisticated phishing and fraudulent schemes where individuals impersonate Anduril representatives, luring job seekers with false interviews or job offers. These scammers often attempt to extract payment or sensitive personal information.

To Ensure Your Safety And Help You Navigate Your Job Search With Confidence, Please Keep The Following Critical Points In Mind

No Financial Requests: Anduril will never solicit payment or demand personal financial details (such as banking information, credit card numbers, or social security numbers) at any stage of our hiring process. Our legitimate recruitment is entirely free for candidates.
Please always verify communications:
Direct from Anduril: If you receive an email from one of our recruiters, it will only come from an @anduril.com address.
Via Agency Partner: If contacted by a recruiting agency for an Anduril role, their email will clearly identify their agency. If you suspect any suspicious activity, please verify the agency's authenticity by reaching out to contact@anduril.com.

Exercise Caution with Unsolicited Outreach: If you receive any communication that appears suspicious, contains grammatical errors, or makes unusual requests, do not engage. Always confirm the sender's email domain is @anduril.com before providing any personal information or clicking on links.
What to Do If You Suspect Fraud: Should you encounter any questionable or fraudulent outreach claiming to be from Anduril, please report it immediately to contact@anduril.com. Your proactive caution is invaluable in protecting your personal information and upholding the security and trustworthiness of our recruitment efforts.
